_doc: Masses that override Fusion's (by component name). Fusion gives every other part's mass from its physical material (PA12 SLS or TPU). mass in kg; null = still to weigh (the build stops, or keeps the Fusion mass with F360_MJCF_PENDING_OK=1). com: optional centre of mass in the component's own frame, mm; without it the CAD centroid is used. The inertia is Fusion's scaled to the mass (uniform density). box: the battery's bounding box as a uniform box. exclude: not on the robot, so no geometry and no mass.
